supportive_discovery_patterns: Mendes/Delta: phallus + spine textual geography coexists with a gold phallus-sheath object and djed imagery in related Mendes-area funerary material, but the two archaeological branches are not directly paired.

First Cataract/Elephantine: leg/foot theology coexists with QH207 repair focused on bronze feet/lower fragments, but causal locality specificity is not established and Fitzenreiter supplies an explicit caution.
Heracleopolis: multi-member textual geography, local Osiris-Naref tradition and a large local bronze Osiris group converge, but no member-specific physical join is recovered.
Dendera-Coptos-Thonis-Giza-Oxyrhynchus independently support a broader material operator grammar of manufacture, containment, deposition and renewal.
reasons_not_to_promote: All eleven operator-matrix sites were already inspected before preregistration and are discovery/calibration data.
The Dendera 42-nome table is still v0.9 pending direct primary facsimile audit.
No held-out archaeological outcomes have been opened.
Several strongest apparent matches have provenance or causal-link gaps.
Member-specific coincidence can be inflated by duplicated relic geography and the high overall prevalence of Osiris images.
evidence_for_current_local_member_operat.current_strongest_admissible_conclusion: The corpus strongly supports multiple recurring material operations by which Osirian bodily identity was manufactured, repaired, enclosed, protected, deposited or renewed. It does not yet establish that local textual body-member assignments predict local archaeological material practice.

decisive_negative_evidence: CG53469 and the Tell el-Rub'a djed are not currently an admissible same-body pair.
QH207 green/original-patina hypothesis is not supported.
QH207 all-fragments-previously-used hypothesis is not admitted.
Abydos human tissue does not identify Osiris.
Dendera manufactured relic/body matter breaks any rule RELIC_TERM => BIOLOGICAL_REMAINS.
Ehnasya 56 bronzes are not a relic cache without context/container evidence.
Oxyrhynchus general cardinal ritual does not establish the individual six-box geometry.
E11072 functional analogy to Oxyrhynchus does not transfer morphology or provenance.
